ledger_rule: The ledger records the transformation, not the world.

receipt_boundary.outside_scope: material for which no correspondence claim is made

latent.definition: Compatible with capture, present near the system, not yet transformed, not irrelevant, not claimed.
latent.purpose: Preserve the boundary between what the system has processed and what exists outside processing. This category carries no payload, only position.
latent.failure_mode_prevented: Calibration drift under internal coherence. Without this state, a ledger of accurate receipts will over time be read as a complete account of the world. Silence accumulates as implicit confirmation.
latent.invariant: Completeness of records is not completeness of world. Absence of a receipt is not evidence of irrelevance or nonexistence.
latent.temporality: Latent status applies only at cycle completion. Do not set retroactively from later absence. Status reflects what the system knew at the intake boundary, not what can be inferred afterward.
latent.usage: Set when a phenomenon is detected as proximate and compatible but not converted to a receipt in this cycle. Do not use for errors, rejections, out-of-scope data, or any state inferred after cycle completion.

preferred_statement: This receipt records a scoped transformation. The threshold existed. Some phenomena did not cross it. Their status remains ambient. Correspondence outside scope is not claimed.
